Kerala Man Arrested After 36 Years for Robbing Bus Ticket Collection

A man has been arrested in Kerala after 36 years for allegedly robbing the collection of bus tickets from a KSRTC bus at gunpoint. The incident occurred on an unspecified date, and the suspect is believed to have evaded capture for nearly four decades. Authorities have confirmed the arrest, but no further details are available. This case highlights the challenges faced by law enforcement agencies in tracking down long-lost fugitives.
